gate: Gate-D step 7 / Gate-E entry; boundary built and scale measured, full run not performed

why_a_separate_boundary.finding: the existing controlled runner cannot express this run and refuses it by construction
why_a_separate_boundary.detail: integration/sumo_execution fixes scenario_directory and config_file as literals, bounds vehicle_count at 1000, and fixes manchester_traffic false. Those are deliberate refusals, so they were left intact and a Manchester boundary was built beside them rather than widening them.

frozen_command.note: paths are substituted into placeholders at run time and never appear in evidence

scale_pilot.purpose: measure whether one-second FCD is tractable at this demand before committing to a full run

inputs.network: Manchester local-authority study subnetwork, 285,794 real edges
inputs.demand: count-constrained candidate demand, 748,589 vehicles across 212,666 flows

projection.why_a_floor: the FCD rate scales with vehicles resident in the network, not with elapsed time. The pilot never reached a steady state, so the true total for the full window is materially higher than this linear projection.

substantive_finding_for_the_owner.summary: the candidate demand does not simulate cleanly at full scale
substantive_finding_for_the_owner.detail: By t=600 half the resident vehicles were halted (49.92%) and 102 teleports had occurred, while the network was still filling. That is congestion forming well before the demand is fully inserted.
substantive_finding_for_the_owner.interpretation: This is a finding about the demand, not a defect in the run. Possible contributors include route concentration from the fixed pool, the absence of any departure-time shaping, and uncalibrated traffic signals. None has been investigated, and the demand has not been adjusted to produce a cleaner picture.
substantive_finding_for_the_owner.why_it_was_not_corrected: tuning the demand until it simulated smoothly would hide exactly what a controlled run exists to reveal, and no such adjustment is authorised
options_for_the_owner: run the full 12-hour window and accept the FCD volume and runtime
run a bounded window, for example one peak hour, for the VEC chain
investigate the saturation before running further
substantive_finding_for_the_owner.not_decided_here: no option has been chosen; the full run was not performed

boundaries_held.failed_run_never_replaces_accepted_outpu: outputs are promoted atomically from private staging only after a zero exit and a digested FCD

explicit_non_claims: simulated traffic under a candidate demand is not observed traffic
no calibration, comparison, or VEC stage was executed
the pilot is a scale measurement, not a result
MAN-09 remains planned; Gate D and Gate E remain foundation_only
